title: QuantDeus Post-Scarcity Civilization Doctrine
objective: Reduce measurable scarcity and expand human flourishing through evidence-first science, automation, resource accounting, ecological restoration, voluntary cooperation and scalable open infrastructure.
operating_rule: Inspiration is not evidence. Every extraordinary technical or historical claim must pass an independent evidence gate before it changes roadmap, code, spending, public claims or outreach.

source_streams.name: THRIVE: What On Earth Will It Take?
source_streams.use: systems mapping, follow-the-incentives analysis, solution discovery, human agency
source_streams.rule: Do not inherit conspiracy, energy, health, UFO or governance claims as facts; independently verify each claim.

source_streams.name: THRIVE II: This Is What It Takes
source_streams.use: scan proposed solutions in energy, health, consciousness and voluntary/decentralized organization
source_streams.rule: Technical efficacy requires primary evidence, reproducibility and failure criteria before promotion.

source_streams.name: The Venus Project / Jacque Fresco
source_streams.use: resource-based-economy framing, cybernation, access, carrying-capacity constraints, closed-loop systems and scientific social design

source_streams.name: Реновация Земли
source_streams.use: volunteer execution, modern scientific correction of legacy ideas, media production and community building

source_streams.name: Рубежи науки / Илья Чех
source_streams.use: fundamental research, space technology, life-support systems, science media, commercialization and long-horizon space capability

evidence_grades.A: independently verifiable primary evidence, reproducible result or deployed system
evidence_grades.B: promising evidence with material uncertainty or limited replication
evidence_grades.C: exploratory hypothesis, proposal, early signal or unverified claim

priority_tracks.energy: abundant clean energy, storage, grid resilience, efficiency and resource productivity
priority_tracks.justice: fair access, transparent allocation, human override, automation dividends and privacy
priority_tracks.unity: voluntary cooperation, open science, Earth restoration and interoperable civic/scientific infrastructure
priority_tracks.space: fundamental physics, life support, ISRU, robotics, propulsion and dual-use Earth/space technologies
priority_tracks.potential: education, health evidence, accessibility, creativity and human-AI augmentation without unsupported medical claims
priority_tracks.synthesis: science communication, future-city visualization, culture and media that convert verified results into participation

forbidden_shortcuts: treating a film claim as scientific proof
calling unreplicated energy devices a breakthrough
medical efficacy claims without high-quality evidence
proxy metrics presented as real-world outcomes
automatic production publishing, spending or irreversible action
